scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Welcome to my Magazine Shop.
As you may know, large numbers
of bullets can be carried more
easily when they're in Magazines. Now, can I interest you in
anything in particular?
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
欢迎光临我的弹匣商店。
如您所知，将子弹装入弹匣后，
携带起来会更方便。那么，
您有什么特别需要的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Welcome to my shop.
Here, I provide Magazines
and Cartridges for Gunslingers.
Sorry, but it doesn't look like
my services would be of any
use to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
欢迎光临我的商店。
这里为神枪手提供弹匣和子弹。
抱歉，看起来我的服务
对您没什么帮助，冒险者。

scripts.text: Wind Sphere Pack
scripts.translation: 风属性子弹盒

scripts.text: Shadow Sphere Pack
scripts.translation: 暗属性子弹盒

scripts.text: Poison Sphere Pack
scripts.translation: 毒物子弹盒

scripts.text: Water Sphere Pack
scripts.translation: 水属性子弹盒

scripts.text: Fire Sphere Pack
scripts.translation: 火属性子弹盒

scripts.text: Cartridge
scripts.translation: 子弹

scripts.text: Blood Cartridge
scripts.translation: 血之子弹

scripts.text: Silver Cartridge
scripts.translation: 银之子弹

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Well, if you ever find
that you have too many
bullets, come and see me.
It's a smart idea to store
bullets with my Magazines.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
如果您发现子弹太多了，
就来找我吧。
用我的弹匣来储存子弹
是个明智的选择。

scripts.text:
Welcome to my shop.
Here, I provide Magazines
and Cartridges for Gunslingers.
Sorry, but it doesn't look like
my services would be of any
use to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
欢迎光临我的商店。
这里为神枪手提供弹匣和子弹。
抱歉，看起来我的服务
对您没什么帮助，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Eh, but if you happen to
know any Gunslingers, send
them my way. You can never
have too many bullets.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
嗯，如果您认识任何神枪手，
请把他们介绍给我。
子弹这种东西，永远嫌多。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Now, you can trade
{0}
and 500 zeny for 1 {1}, so make sure
you have sufficient bullets
and zeny for this exchange.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
现在，您可以使用
{0}
和500 Zeny兑换1个{1}，
请确保您有足够的子弹
和Zeny来进行兑换。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
You can exchange {0} and 500 zeny
with 1 {1}.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
您可以使用{0}和500 Zeny
兑换1个{1}。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Remember that I can't give
you more than 50 Magazines
at a time. Now please enter
the number of Magazines you
want to receive. If you want to cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
请记住，我一次最多只能
给您50个弹匣。现在请输入
您想要兑换的弹匣数量。
如果您想取消，请输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Hey, I can't give you
that many Magazines.
Please try again, and
enter a number no
greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
嘿，我没法给您那么多弹匣。
请重试，输入一个
不超过50的数字。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Hey, you've got a lot
of junk crammed in your
Inventory. Free up some
space, and then come back
and trade your bullets for
some Magazines later, okay?
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
嘿，您的物品栏里塞满了
没用的东西。腾出一些空间，
然后再回来用子弹兑换弹匣，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Alright, here are
your Magazines. Thanks
for visiting my shop, and
I hope that you use all
of your ammo wisely.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
好的，这是您的弹匣。
感谢光临我的商店，
希望您能明智地使用弹药。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny for
this Magazine exchange.
Come back to my shop
after you've saved up
some more money.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法进行这次弹匣兑换。
请攒够钱后再来我的商店。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Sorry, but you don't
have enough bullets for
this Magazine exchange.
Maybe you should double
check your Inventory, and
then come back to me later.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
抱歉，您的子弹不足，
无法进行这次弹匣兑换。
建议您检查一下物品栏，
然后稍后再来找我。
